name: Our First Love
overview: Scripture emphasizes that Jesus Christ is to be our first love, commanding us to love God with all our heart, soul, mind, and strength, as the greatest commandment (Matthew 22:37; Mark 12:30). This love is foundational and must remain fervent, for the increase of sin causes many to grow cold in love (Matthew 24:12). The ultimate demonstration of love is Christ's sacrificial death for His friends (John 15:13), and believers are identified by their love for one another, reflecting the love God showed by giving His only Son for our salvation (John 3:16; John 13:35).
